selection_note: Evidence-led London DJ opportunities for a house, techno and electronic DJ seeking first public sets. Exact future dates are included only where a current organiser, venue or ticketing page publishes them. Recurring and submission routes remain clearly labelled when no one-off date is required.
safety_note: Equipment is marked confirmed only when a current organiser or venue publishes it. Contact and application routes are for Phil to use manually; no bookings, submissions or outreach have been made.

opportunities.schedule: Every Wednesday in 2026, 19:00-23:00; next occurrence Wednesday 18 November
opportunities.genres: All danceable genres; house and electronic welcome
opportunities.opportunity: Walk in and ask at the bar to have your name added for the organiser-run open-decks night.
opportunities.equipment: Vinyl, CD and digital DJ equipment supplied by OpenDecks; contact the organiser if you need exact model compatibility.
opportunities.evidence_note: The current OpenDecks cities page says the Shoreditch Balls event runs every Wednesday during 2026 and provides DJs with its own vinyl, CD and digital equipment.
opportunities.next_action: Go this Wednesday with a Rekordbox USB, headphones and a tight 15-20 minute house set; confirm digital format with OpenDecks first.
opportunities.constraint: Walk-in signup means a set is not guaranteed.

opportunities.opportunity: Free open decks. RSVP, then select a timed slot on the day. Sets are 15 minutes and may run longer when no DJ follows.
opportunities.equipment: Pioneer XDJ-RX2, Rekordbox only. Bring a compatible USB and headphones.
opportunities.evidence_note: The live organiser listing publishes seven future dates, timed on-the-day signup, 15-minute sets and the XDJ-RX2 Rekordbox setup.
opportunities.next_action: RSVP for 19 November, prepare three short Rekordbox playlists and arrive before the popular slots fill.
opportunities.constraint: Outside Central London, but currently the clearest low-friction route to a live set.

opportunities.schedule: Tuesday 24 November and Tuesday 22 December; open decks 18:00-22:00
opportunities.genres: All genres; house and electronic welcome
opportunities.opportunity: Free open-decks ticket at BOXPARK's BEATBOX. An optional beginners workshop runs 16:00-18:00 for £20 plus fees.
opportunities.equipment: A venue DJ setup is supplied, but current official pages do not publish the player and mixer models. Confirm USB format before attending.
opportunities.contact_name: On The Rise DJ Academy / BOXPARK
opportunities.evidence_note: Current official BOXPARK and ticket pages publish both future dates and say the open decks are open to all DJs and genres.
opportunities.next_action: Book the free open-decks ticket for 24 November and ask the organiser which Rekordbox export format and headphones are required.
opportunities.constraint: The workshop is paid; choose the separate free open-decks ticket if you only want to play.

opportunities.genres: House, techno and other electronic genres
opportunities.opportunity: Open-decks draw with 20-minute sets. The organiser describes it as open to bedroom and experienced DJs.
opportunities.equipment: Pioneer XDJ-XZ plus XDJ-700. Bring a Pioneer/Rekordbox-formatted USB and headphones; no laptops.
opportunities.evidence_note: The current ticket and organiser pages publish the 2 December date, 20-minute format and exact Pioneer setup.
opportunities.next_action: Book the DJ ticket, prepare a 20-minute Rekordbox set and arrive early for registration.
opportunities.constraint: DJ entry is low-cost rather than free, and a slot is not guaranteed.

opportunities.schedule: Programming and residency proposals accepted year-round
opportunities.genres: Electronic, house, club and eclectic DJ programming
opportunities.opportunity: The official venue route still invites proposals for music, DJs, launch nights and residencies. Pitch a no-fee early set or trial house residency.
opportunities.equipment: Downstairs: 2× Pioneer CDJ-2000NXS2, DJM-900NXS2 and 2× Technics 1210s. Ground floor: 2× CDJ-900NXS, DJM-750MK2 and 2× PLX-1000.
opportunities.evidence_note: The venue's current hire/programming route explicitly welcomes DJ and night proposals; its current technical specification lists both booths.
opportunities.next_action: Send one concise personalised proposal with a 30-minute house mix and offer a quiet-night or early warm-up trial.
opportunities.constraint: Curated venue. A specific concept and strong mix will outperform a generic request.

opportunities.schedule: Every Thursday, 19:00-22:00; next explicitly published date 19 November
opportunities.genres: All genres and abilities; harder techno requested after 21:30
opportunities.opportunity: Sign up on the night for a 30-minute vinyl open-decks slot.
opportunities.equipment: Vinyl-only setup. Current ticket discovery copy names Technics 1210s; bring your own records and headphones.
opportunities.evidence_note: The current official page confirms weekly Thursday signup for all skill levels and vinyl DJs; current ticketing confirms the 19 November occurrence.
opportunities.next_action: Use only if you can prepare a vinyl house set; email or arrive before 19:00 to confirm signup order.
opportunities.constraint: Vinyl-only, so not suitable for a USB-only set.

opportunities.opportunity: Free basement open-decks session with Mark Shadow for DJs and collectors of all levels.
opportunities.equipment: Vinyl only. The current listing does not publish the turntable and mixer models.
opportunities.evidence_note: The current Resident Advisor listing publishes the 9 December date and describes a free vinyl open-decks session for all levels.
opportunities.next_action: Ask the organiser through the listing how slots are allocated before travelling, then prepare a short vinyl house selection.
opportunities.constraint: Vinyl-only and outside the original central-London radius.

opportunities.genres: House, tech house, minimal, deep tech, speed garage and electronic
opportunities.opportunity: Submit an unpublished guest mix for The Vault. Successful guests may be offered their own show when live broadcasting resumes.
opportunities.equipment: No venue booth required. Submit a downloadable SoundCloud or Dropbox mix link.
opportunities.evidence_note: The live official application page currently requests guest mixes in Phil's target electronic genres.
opportunities.next_action: Record an unpublished 60-minute house/tech-house mix, enable downloads and submit it through the application form.
opportunities.constraint: No previously public sets, commercial mashups, pop remixes, mainstream mainroom material or open-format sets.

opportunities.genres: House, tech house, progressive and techno
opportunities.opportunity: Selected mixes receive a dedicated post and promotion through TRIP's channels.
opportunities.equipment: No venue equipment required. Supply a public SoundCloud or Mixcloud link, tracklist, artist photo, socials and genres.
opportunities.evidence_note: TRIP's live official form currently accepts full-length house and techno mixes.
opportunities.next_action: Finish a polished 60-minute mix with tracklist and artwork, then submit the public link.
opportunities.constraint: Selective and unpaid; the mix must be at least 60 minutes and following one of TRIP's channels is required.

opportunities.genres: Electronic dance music, house and techno
opportunities.opportunity: Submit an electronic DJ mix for possible airing or publication by the London station.
opportunities.equipment: No venue equipment required. Submit a direct SoundCloud or Mixcloud link.
opportunities.evidence_note: The live official submission page currently accepts one-hour electronic dance mixes and publishes the required format.
opportunities.next_action: Submit one focused 60-minute house mix with a direct playable link and clear DJ/mix title.
opportunities.constraint: Electronic dance music only; the station rejects hip-hop, R&B and submissions that do not follow its format.

opportunities.schedule: Monthly concept; no next On Wax date currently published
opportunities.genres: Eclectic selectors with regular house programming
opportunities.opportunity: The official On Wax page remains live as a route for upcoming London vinyl talent, but the current November 2026-March 2027 programme does not show a new date.
opportunities.equipment: Bespoke DJ booth and Klipsch/Tannoy hybrid sound system. On Wax is vinyl-only; current public pages do not name turntable models.
opportunities.evidence_note: The official submission page remains online, but no future On Wax date is present in the venue's current programme.
opportunities.next_action: Email a concise vinyl-house submission or monitor the programme for the next On Wax announcement.
opportunities.constraint: Vinyl-only and currently awaiting a confirmed date.

opportunities.schedule: Current programming and proposal route; no public beginner slot
opportunities.genres: House, deep house, tech house and electronic
opportunities.opportunity: The venue retains a current programming/proposal route and hosts promoter-led house nights. Target a compatible promoter for a free opening set.
opportunities.equipment: Official current technical information confirms a club DJ setup; verify the exact configuration for the chosen night with its promoter.
opportunities.evidence_note: The official site continues to publish event programming and proposal information; there is no open beginner call.

opportunities.constraint: A promoter relationship is the realistic route; do not send a generic venue request.

opportunities.schedule: Collaboration enquiries open; no public DJ slot
opportunities.genres: Late-night global dance and electronic programming
opportunities.opportunity: The independent venue still publishes a collaboration route, but no current open-decks call was found.

opportunities.schedule: Active electronic programme; no public artist-submission route
opportunities.opportunity: Strong genre fit, but the current route is through compatible event promoters rather than an unsolicited venue pitch.
opportunities.equipment: Professional event setup, but exact DJ equipment should be confirmed with the promoter for each night.
opportunities.evidence_note: The current official programme shows active electronic events but no public artist-submission route.
